title: stichorkis coelogynoides
intro: Stichorkis coelogynoides, commonly known as the yellow orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. As a medicinal plant, it is used for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stichorkis coelogynoides include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
